title: UK games industry sees 1,537 development job losses in a year, 'decline of unprecedented scale and speed' — TIGA report
content: The UK games industry is experiencing 'a decline of unprecedented scale and speed' according to the latest research by trade association TIGA. The report found 1,537 development jobs were lost in the sector during the year-long period leading up to September 2025, marking the first downturn in 14 years. Studio numbers have fallen and startup companies are struggling to secure funding.
